name: RC-B10-0216/2026 – § 4 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the new Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
part_text: 4.Calls on the Member States and the European External Action Service to raise these issues in the next EU-China Human Rights Dialogue, as they could lead to severe consequences for EU-China relations, including the activation of the EU Global Human Rights Sanctions Regime;
